Sandbox_CookieMastery_Announce_tooltip: Tell everyone when someone reaches mastery Lv 10 and when a Lv 10 master dies (Hall of Fame)
Sandbox_CookieMastery_ApprenticeBonus_to: Extra skill XP (%%) in the mentor's branch while the mentor (Lv 3+) is online, at any distance
Sandbox_CookieMastery_ApprenticeLevelPoi: Mastery points the mentor gets each time their apprentice gains a skill level
Sandbox_CookieMastery_ApprenticeSwapDays: Real days a player must wait before choosing a different apprentice
Sandbox_CookieMastery_BarPoints_tooltip: Overflow XP worth one full level-10 bar of that skill
Sandbox_CookieMastery_BookBonus_tooltip: Extra skill XP (%%) in the book's branch while a master book is active
Sandbox_CookieMastery_BookDays_tooltip: Real days a master must wait between writing two master books
Sandbox_CookieMastery_BookHours_tooltip: Real hours a master book stays active after it is read
Sandbox_CookieMastery_BuildHpBase_toolti: Extra HP (%%) on things a Lv 1 builder builds
Sandbox_CookieMastery_BuildHpPerLevel_to: Lv 10 = the Lv 1 value + 9 x this value
Sandbox_CookieMastery_CapPerMinute: Max points per player per minute
Sandbox_CookieMastery_Enabled_tooltip: Off = overflow XP is not counted
Sandbox_CookieMastery_LegacyBookHours_to: Real hours the last book lasts. A Lv 10 master who dies leaves it to their apprentice
Sandbox_CookieMastery_LevelBase_tooltip: Overflow points a skill needs for mastery Lv 1. Later levels grow by the level growth option
Sandbox_CookieMastery_LiveBoard: Hall of Fame: show living TOP 5
Sandbox_CookieMastery_LiveBoard_tooltip: On = everyone sees the name, branch and level of the five strongest living masters
Sandbox_CookieMastery_MentorBonus_toolti: Extra skill XP (%%) for a player near an active master (Lv 3+) of the same branch. Not added on top of the apprentice bonus
Sandbox_CookieMastery_MentorRadius_toolt: How close (tiles) a player must stand to an active master of the same branch to get the mentor bonus
Sandbox_CookieMastery_MentorWindow_toolt: Seconds a master (Lv 3+) counts as active after gaining XP in their branch
Sandbox_CookieMastery_RepairNailsPerFull: Counted by how damaged it is, rounded up
Sandbox_CookieMastery_RepairPlanksPerFul: Counted by how damaged it is, rounded up
Sandbox_CookieMastery_ReportSeconds: Unused (XP is counted on the server)
Sandbox_CookieMastery_ReportSeconds_tool: Not used since 0.4.1 (XP is counted on the server). Kept so older sandbox files still load
